cases.name: late-analysis-confirm
failed_assertions: Newly completed pending result must remain durable after an older confirmation
Newly completed result must retain its runtime owner and report
Newly completed result must keep its writing/owner until teacher reviews the changed context

steps: First tab contains Bob current writing/photo and a persisted Bob pending result.
Open Portfolio, choose Alice, click the shipped Reassess Writing button and hold its actual confirmation.
Open a second app tab in the same browser context; choose Alice in Portfolio, click Remove from Portfolio and confirm Remove Entry.
Wait until the first tab findPortfolioSession also sees the deleted source; first tab confirmation remains open.
Click Load for Reassessment in the first tab.
exact_user_paths.observed: The source stays deleted and its tombstone stays saved, but the first tab loads captured Alice writing/photo, switches current owner Bob to Alice and grade 5 to 6, publishes a reassessment source pointing at the deleted entry, and clears Bob pending data from runtime and storage.
exact_user_paths.expected_contract: Revalidate source after consent; if missing/changed, stop before mutating current work/preferences and ask teacher to retry.
exact_user_paths.user_reachability: Only synthetic initial records are seeded. Both reassessment and deletion use real shipped button handlers and dialogs. No forced clicks, beneath-modal interaction, replacement wftConfirm, direct storage mutation during confirmation, or fake storage event.
exact_user_paths.limits: Deletion of the saved source is not undone by confirmation. This is a stale load and displacement of current work, not saved-history resurrection.

steps: Enter synthetic Bob writing and click the shipped Analyze Writing button.
Hold the first synthetic AI completion; the real analysis remains in progress.
Click Portfolio, choose Alice and click Reassess Writing; its real confirmation opens while Bob analysis is still running.
Release the synthetic AI completion. All three real pipeline steps finish behind the modal, creating latestAnalysisData and a newly persisted pending Bob assessment.
Click Load for Reassessment on the earlier prompt, whose text has no pending-result replacement warning.
exact_user_paths.observed: Before acceptance: pending Bob session sess_1792109752807_oh87mf exists in runtime and localStorage and its report is populated. After acceptance: both pending copies and latestAnalysisData are null; writing and current owner change to Alice. The pending Bob assessment was never committed to the saved portfolio.
exact_user_paths.expected_contract: Do not discard newly arrived pending work under a confirmation built before that result existed. A safe minimal behavior is abort and ask teacher to review/retry.
exact_user_paths.user_reachability: Only callOpenRouter completion strings are simulated. Analysis entry, every intermediate parser/renderer/pending-persistence step, navigation, reassessment and confirmation use the real app. No current owner/writing/pending assignment occurs while the modal is open.
exact_user_paths.limits: No live AI or Drive calls. The loss is the synthetic current assessment/draft; saved portfolio history is unchanged.

policy_basis: The visible pending-result warning is decided before the await and is absent for the result that arrives later. Preserving changed work until renewed teacher review is the explicit regression contract, inferred from campaign saved-work safety and existing ownership/pending-preservation tests. No claim that a general modal should freeze all background work, and no repair is applied in this stage.

smallest_proposed_next_stage_fix.location: reassessPortfolioSession only, before any post-confirmation grade/preference/current-work mutation
smallest_proposed_next_stage_fix.approach: Capture the original source snapshot, current writing context and pending-result snapshot before wftConfirm. After acceptance, re-read source and compare source contents/identity plus current writing/pending context. If any relevant context changed, alert and return with current work/preferences intact. Use existing helpers and preserve normal/cancel/grade-failure behavior. Keep source/owner validation through image restore and later portfolio commit.

smallest_proposed_next_stage_fix.policy_choice: Abort/retry is the smallest proposed behavior. Automatically accepting the newest source or silently discarding a newly completed result would require a different policy decision.
